notes.implied_move_method: UNFI lists monthly options only; first expiry after the print is 2026-09-18 (10 days after). Raw ATM (K=44) straddle mid = $5.78 = 13.15% of spot. Decomposed via J^2 = T1*(sigma_front^2 - sigma_base^2): 11.85% using Oct-16 ATM IV 56.0% as base, 12.80% using Nov-20 ATM IV 49.7%. Straddle x 0.85 heuristic = 11.17%. Headline 11.9% is the Oct-base decomposition. No third-party published implied move for UNFI was found.

notes.direction_rationale: Modestly negative lean. Down: negative run-in with a 6-of-7 historical hit rate; consensus EPS at the top of the company's own guided Q4 range with zero 30-day revision and 0.00% Earnings ESP; Natural segment growth halved over three quarters against Sprouts comps -1.0%, NGVC -14% in 21d, grocery units -2% y/y and SNAP enrolment -5.6M y/y; a CFO 29 days into the job setting the first FY27 bar amid the densest C-suite turnover in years; the only directional insider datapoint is a discretionary non-10b5-1 sale of 16% of a divisional president's holding. Up: the last two fiscal-Q4 guidance prints moved +30.6% and +18.5%; the 2025-09-30 precedent of guiding profit above and sales below consensus produced +18.45%; the stock is already -20.9% in 63 sessions with no identified catalyst and below every post-Q3 price target but one; the guided Q4 EBITDA bar is low in absolute terms; $18M asset-sale gain already disclosed; $109M buyback authorization unused on a program lapsing this month.
